concept: DR for S3: Cross-Region Replication + Route 53 failover
tests: How to keep static S3 content available if an entire Region fails (choose two).
expected: S3 Cross-Region Replication to a bucket in a second Region + Route 53 failover routing between the primary and the replica. Triggers: "entire Region unavailable", "static website content remains accessible".
why_not: Versioning and changing storage class work within a single Region; Transfer Acceleration only speeds up uploads.
